claims.sourceText: Peter W. Merlin biography, Dreamland Resort, https://www.dreamlandresort.com/team/peter.html , opened 2026-09-18
claims.text: His biography records a Bachelor of Science degree in Aeronautical Studies from Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University in Daytona Beach, Florida; that he 'has been researching the history of Area 51 since 1984'; that he co-founded the X-Hunters Aerospace Archeology Team; and authorship or co-authorship of Mach 3+: NASA/USAF YF-12 Flight Research 1969-1979 (NASA, 2001), The Smell of Kerosene: A Test Pilot's Odyssey (NASA, 2003), From Archangel to Senior Crown: Design and Development of the Blackbird (AIAA, 2008), X-Plane Crashes (Specialty Press, 2008), Unlimited Horizons: Design and Development of the U-2 (NASA, 2015), Images of America: Nevada Test Site (Arcadia, 2016), Images of America: Tonopah Test Range (Arcadia, 2021) and DREAMLAND: The Secret History of Area 51 (Schiffer, 2023).

title: Peter W. Merlin, 'Historian and Aerospace Archeologist', biography page on Dreamland Resort
